title: Frontend integration gate: hosted functional checks are advisory for the dev release verdict (RC1 step 6)

operator_decision.authority: Operator decision 2026-11-17 ('依照你的建議來做') in Remediation Plan 2026-11-17 (AGENTS.md PR #7483; docs/deployment/SD_DEV_DEPLOY_ACCEPTANCE_SPLIT_2026-11-17.md PR #7484; docs/operations/problem-register.md class RC1 step 6)
operator_decision.rule: For dev only, a deploy is build plus switch plus stack health and only an unhealthy stack rolls back; hosted functional checks and the management page crawl are classified advisory for the dev release verdict, recorded in the gate report in machine-readable form for the post-switch acceptance stage, and do not reject the deployable artifact upload. Staging and production remain gate-before-switch.

residual_findings.finding: scripts/git/check_generated_files.py lists '.lovable/audits/' in FORBIDDEN_PREFIXES without an allowlist for the tracked file .lovable/audits/release-gate-exceptions.md, so any edit to .lovable/audits/release-gate-exceptions.md fails Branch CI Gate ('Generated files guard'). Since scripts/git/check_generated_files.py is outside this task's artifact contract, gate documentation was recorded in .github/workflows/pantheon-integration-gate.yml, scripts/aggregate-release-gate.mjs, and this evidence manifest.

Gate 3 step mgmt_live_deep (scripts/validate-management-live-deep.mjs) opens /bff/events/stream against PANTHEON_BFF_BASE_URL for 65s during the pre-switch integration gate and is evaluated via liveDeepGateStatus rather than hostedStatus. It is outside this task's Gate 8 hosted-check scope and pinned by existing Gate 3 tests, so it was left unchanged; recorded for RC1 step 5 post-deploy acceptance stage follow-up if SSE stream instability occurs during pre-switch builds.
